record.paper_title: Some Open Problems in Dynamical Systems
record.original_question: For G^1_μ(D²), let G be the set of maps f with λ⁺(f,μ) = 0, where λ⁺ is the maximal integrated Lyapunov exponent. Which of the following two mutually exclusive alternatives holds: (a) G is a dense G_δ subset, or (b) there exists a nonempty C¹-open set U and a constant δ > 0 such that every g in U satisfies h_μ(g) ≥ δ?

evidence.quote: Question. Is a) or b) true ?

artifact.category_tag: Lyapunov exponents and entropy of conservative diffeomorphisms
artifact.status_search_result: No published resolution of this specific dichotomy for $C^1$ area-preserving diffeomorphisms of the disk was located. Closely related results exist (Bochi's theorem on generic zero Lyapunov exponents for $C^1$ area-preserving surface diffeomorphisms, and the Bochi–Mañé–Viana dichotomy), but a definitive answer specifying which of the two alternatives holds for $\mathrm{Diff}^1_\mu(D^2)$ in the stated form was not found, so the status appears to remain undetermined.

status_evidence.title: Genericity of zero Lyapunov exponents (Bochi)
status_evidence.snippet: For any compact surface, there is a residual (dense G_δ) set of C^1 area preserving diffeomorphisms which either are Anosov or have zero Lyapunov exponents a.e.
status_evidence.claim: Bochi's theorem provides a generic dichotomy on closed surfaces but does not by itself settle alternative (a) vs (b) on the disk with the entropy formulation.

status_evidence.title: Lyapunov exponents: how frequently are dynamical systems hyperbolic? (Bochi–Viana)
status_evidence.snippet: A dichotomy: either all exponents vanish a.e. or the Oseledets splitting extends to a dominated splitting on the whole manifold.
status_evidence.claim: The Bochi–Mañé–Viana dichotomy is a related framework, but does not directly resolve the stated open question for $D^2$.
